meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会复现并排查 bug,对照两侧源码确认根因与归属仓库,再提交含复现步骤、根因和修复建议的 GitHub issue,并打 lazycodex-generated 标签;仅 openai/codex 可开 PR。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或分类 LazyCodex、Codex 插件或上游 Codex CLI 的 bug 时触发。

say.text: 装 omo-codex 插件时报错,帮我提个 issue
say.note: 会查源码定位归属仓库并提交 issue

say.text: 这个 bug 在干净的 Codex CLI 上也能复现,帮我开 issue
先搜下 openai/codex 有没有同样问题,有就补证据
say.note: 已有相同 issue 就评论而非新建

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reproduces and investigates the bug, checks both sources to confirm root cause and repo ownership, then files a GitHub issue with repro steps, root cause, and fix guidance, labeled lazycodex-generated. PRs only for openai/codex.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug.

say_en.text: Installing an omo-codex plugin fails, please file an issue for me
say_en.note: Finds the owning repo and files the issue

say_en.text: This bug also reproduces on clean Codex CLI, please open an issue
Search openai/codex for the same issue and add my evidence
say_en.note: Comments instead of filing a duplicate
